message.content: According to the conversation records, Li Hua informed Adam Smith multiple times that she had transferred the rent. This indicates that Li Hua informed Adam Smith about the rent transfer on January 27, 2026. However, she also mentions this again on Source 4, dated 20260602_10:00, stating, "Hi Adam, just wanted to let you know that I've transferred the rent. Sorry for the delay!"
